name: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)
owner: European Environment Agency for the European Commission (Copernicus)
gives: CORINE Land Cover, high-resolution layers, urban atlas, Europe-wide, Portugal included

why.quote: Free, full and open access to the products and services of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service is made on the conditions that: ... users shall inform the public of the source of these products ...
why.basis: data policy (full, open and free access; attribution required, changes to be stated, no impression of EU endorsement); robots.txt: 'Disallow: /api' and '/en/sandbox'

interface: Downloads and view and download services from the portal; the /api path is disallowed by robots.txt, so it must not be used. Whether bulk download needs an EU Login was not confirmed.
notes: Large rasters and vectors (hundreds of MB to GB), useful for maps, not for news cycles; a low priority. Required wording for derivatives: 'Generated using European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service information'. Whether it is keyless is unconfirmed (probably an EU Login for downloads), so treat as not buildable until checked.
